settings.label: Application Client ID
settings.help: Public OAuth application identifier. Required for Connect with; manual tokens can be entered without it.

settings.label: Channel
settings.help: Channel slug from live.vkvideo.ru, without the URL.

authentication.help: Register an application in the VK Video Live developer console (sign-in may use VK ID). DevAPI issues a separate token. Public chat and audience reading do not require privileged scopes. Sending requires a user token with chat:message:send; native polls are unavailable.

native.instructions: Create a DevAPI OAuth application in the VK Video Live developer portal with the implicit response_type=token flow enabled. Add the exact OAuth redirect URI below and copy the application Client ID into Application Client ID above Connect. The portal may require VK ID sign-in; VK ID tokens cannot replace DevAPI tokens. This flow needs no application secret. Chat and audience reading request no privileged scopes; enable Send chat to request chat:message:send. Native polls are unavailable.

browser.instructions: Create a DevAPI OAuth application with the implicit response_type=token flow enabled. Register the exact redirect URI below, including its path, and enter the public Client ID above Connect. Allow popups. No application secret is used; VK ID sign-in and DevAPI access tokens are distinct. Chat and audience reading request no privileged scopes. Enable Send chat to request chat:message:send. Native polls are unavailable.

chat_presentation.help: Live stream chat. Sending requires an active stream and chat:message:send permission; reconnect after enabling Send chat.
